# Stakeholder Fixture Source Pack Template

## Purpose

Use this template when a real state, industry, rural, local, transit, or
community requirement is ready to become a requirement-to-refinement fixture.

This template does not create stakeholder endorsement, official-plan status,
construction readiness, eligibility, compliance, guaranteed service, numeric
ROI, or public-review readiness.

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| Fixture ID |  |
| Stakeholder lane | state DOT / freight industry / rural farmer / rural resident / local official / transit-dependent / environmental community / other |
| Source pack owner |  |
| Meeting / intake artifact |  |
| Source-backed requirement |  |
| Affected geography / zone |  |
| Claim posture before fixture | story-ready / heuristic / source-needed / held |
| Intended ROUTE artifact to change | candidate row / hold label / source pack / map caption / demo command / evidence label |

## Required Role Review

| Role Lane | Required When | Review Question | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scope Keeper | every fixture | Does the fixture remain an intake/evidence artifact rather than a project approval? | pending |
| Citation Auditor | every source-backed row | Is every external or meeting source traceable by title, owner, date, and access note? | pending |
| Numeracy Checker | any numeric field | Are units, thresholds, price years, and calculations explicit and internally consistent? | pending |
| Optimization Methodologist | any artifact or label change | Is the before/after change reproducible and not hand-shaped into a desired answer? | pending |
| State DOT Planner | state or delivery claims | Are authority, funding, ROW, maintenance, phasing, and environmental process still bounded? | pending |
| Freight Economist / Freight Industry | freight claims | Are OD, reliability, HOS, parking, weight, clearance, dwell, and operating constraints sourced? | pending |
| Rural Advocate / rural stakeholder | rural or agricultural access claims | Are farm, production, healthcare, evacuation, and local-access needs source-backed rather than assumed? | pending |
| Foxx / Environmental Community | community or environmental claims | Are affected communities, health, noise, runoff, habitat, displacement, and cost burdens visible? | pending |
| Schematic Cartographer | map or stop claim | Does any map or stop artifact preserve topology and avoid proof-by-picture? | pending |

## Closeout Gate

| Gate Item | Required Before Stronger Claim |
|---|---|
| Source custody complete. | Every source row has owner, title, date/year, path or access note, and reviewer. |
| Before/after artifact captured. | Command, artifact path, label change, row count where applicable, and non-claim boundary are recorded. |
| Dissent preserved. | Any role hold remains visible instead of being collapsed into consensus. |
| Prohibited claims absent. | No endorsement, official-plan, construction, guaranteed-SLA, numeric ROI, eligibility, compliance, or public-readiness claim is promoted. |

## Gate

Decision: held_template

Rationale: This template defines the missing source-backed stakeholder fixture
shape for Round 5 follow-through. It does not close a real fixture until an
actual source-backed requirement, artifact change, and role-review record are
filled in.
